settings.label: Settings
settings.gpuRenderingHint: Turn it off if the terminal shows garbled text.
settings.notificationsHint: When a Session in the background waits for you or finishes.

explorer.label: Sessions
explorer.heading: Sessions
explorer.empty: Find every Session here, grouped by Project.
explorer.openElsewhereTooltip: Open elsewhere. It can be resumed here once it ends.

delete.title: Move this Session to the Recycle Bin?
delete.body: "{{title}}" and its history leave ClaudeForge and Claude Code. You can restore them from the Windows Recycle Bin.
delete.onlyPast: Only a Session that has ended can be moved to the Recycle Bin.
delete.gone: This Session is no longer in Claude Code’s history.
delete.failed: ClaudeForge could not move its history to the Recycle Bin. Close anything that has its files open, then try again.

extensions.heading: Extensions
extensions.signInHint: Sign in with /mcp in a Session
extensions.emptyProject: {{project}} has no Extensions of its own.
extensions.claudeFailed: Claude Code could not list the MCP servers and plugins.
extensions.loadFailed: The Extensions could not be read.

mcpServer.title: Remove {{name}}?
mcpServer.body: Claude Code removes this MCP server from {{scope}}. New Sessions start without it; add it again to get it back.
mcpServer.shared: If the Project shares this server in its .mcp.json, Claude Code removes it from there, for everyone working on the Project.

plugin.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
plugin.body: Claude Code uninstalls this plugin from {{scope}}, with the skills, subagents and MCP servers it brings. Install it again from its marketplace to get it back.
plugin.shared: It is installed in the Project’s shared settings (.claude/settings.json): uninstalling it changes them for everyone working on the Project.

notice.outdated_one: {{count}} open Session still uses the previous setup.
notice.outdated_other: {{count}} open Sessions still use the previous setup.

installPlugin.failed: Claude Code could not list the marketplaces’ plugins.
installPlugin.more: The first {{shown}} of {{count}}: search to find the others.

newFile.name: Name
newFile.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It names the file too.

exists.skill: There is already a skill named {{name}} here.
exists.subagent: There is already a subagent named {{name}} here.

newFile.badName: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, 64 at most.
newFile.failed: The file could not be created. Check that the folder can be written to, then try again.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.empty: Open a folder to start a Session in it.
terminal.dormant: Select a tab to resume its Session.
terminal.failed: Claude Code could not start in this folder.

typed.label: Typed, not sent
typed.ticket: Ready to start {{ticket}} from {{map}}. Check the command below, then press Enter.
typed.map: Ready to run Wayfinder on {{ticket}} as a Map of its own. Check the command below, then press Enter.

stop.title: Claude is still working in this Session. Stop it?
stop.body: Its claude process ends and the tab closes. The conversation so far stays in Claude Code’s history.

discard.title: Discard your changes to {{name}}?
discard.body: The tab closes and the file stays as it was last saved.

editor.label: Text of {{name}}
editor.loadFailed: The file could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted.
editor.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Check that it can be written to, then save again.

problem.noFrontmatter: Start the file with its frontmatter: fields between two lines of ---.
problem.notFields: Write the frontmatter as fields, one name: value per line.
problem.badName: Write name in lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 64 at most.

closing.title_one: Claude is still working in a Session. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.title_other: Claude is still working in {{count}} Sessions. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.body: Closing stops every claude process ClaudeForge started. Each Session comes back as a tab the next time you open ClaudeForge, and the conversation so far stays in Claude Code’s history.

map.label: Map
map.heading: Map
map.allDecided: Every Ticket of this Map is decided.
map.fit: Fit the Map to the panel

tooltip.parent_one: {{name}} · {{count}} Sub-ticket. Open it to see it.
tooltip.parent_other: {{name}} · {{count}} Sub-tickets. Open it to see them.

map.unsupported: This Project’s Tracker is not supported yet.
map.unsupportedNamed: This Project’s Tracker, {{name}}, is not supported yet.
map.loadError: This Map could not be read. Check its map.md and Ticket files.
map.loadErrorGitHub: This Map could not be read from GitHub. Refresh to try again.

problem.ghMissing: GitHub CLI is not installed. Install it from cli.github.com, then restart ClaudeForge.
problem.ghSignedOut: GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run gh auth login, then refresh.
problem.noGitHubRepository: GitHub CLI finds no GitHub repository for this Project. Add a GitHub remote, then refresh.
problem.ghFailed: GitHub could not be read through GitHub CLI. Refresh to try again.

map.chooseMap: Show another Map of this Project
map.question: Question
map.crumbs: Where you are in the Map
map.runAsMap: Run Wayfinder on this Ticket in a new Session
map.runAsMapHint: Treats {{name}} as a Map of its own: {{command}} is typed in a new Session, not sent.

details.blockedOutside_one: Blocked by {{count}} open issue outside this Map.
details.blockedOutside_other: Blocked by {{count}} open issues outside this Map.
details.parentWaits: Blocked: its Parent Ticket waits for what blocks it.
details.openFailed: The issue could not be opened.

missing.title: Claude Code was not found
missing.lead: ClaudeForge runs the Claude Code you already have installed. It looked for claude on your PATH and did not find it.
missing.install: Install Claude Code by following the <guide>installation guide</guide>.
missing.checkAgain: Come back and select Check again. You sign in to Claude inside ClaudeForge's terminal, the first time a Session starts.
missing.choose: Installed it somewhere else? Choose claude.exe yourself. ClaudeForge remembers the location.

outdated.title: Claude Code {{version}} is too old
outdated.lead: ClaudeForge needs Claude Code {{minimumVersion}} or later, so that every feature behaves as it should.
outdated.update: Update it by running claude update in a terminal, or by following the installation guide.
outdated.choose: Have a newer one somewhere else? Choose claude.exe yourself. ClaudeForge remembers the location.
